rules.content:
SELECT la.dealership_id, la.dealership_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT la.application_id) AS application_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT la.applicant_ssn) AS unique_applicants,
       MIN(la.application_date) AS first_application,
       MAX(la.application_date) AS last_application,
       SUM(la.requested_loan_amount) AS total_requested
FROM loan_applications la
WHERE la.loan_type = 'auto'
AND la.application_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY la.dealership_id, la.dealership_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.application_id) >= 3
AND DATEDIFF('day', MIN(la.application_date), MAX(la.application_date)) <= 14
ORDER BY total_requested DESC;
rules.title: Auto Loan Application Clustering — Same Dealership / Short Window (SQL)

rules.content:
index=telematics sourcetype=vehicle_gps
| lookup auto_loans loan_id OUTPUT origination_date, borrower_zip, loan_amount, vehicle_value
| eval days_since_origination = (now() - strptime(origination_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400
| where days_since_origination < 60
| where vehicle_value > 30000
| iplookup geo_data lat lng OUTPUT region, country
| where country != borrower_country
| stats count by loan_id, vehicle_vin, origination_date, last_known_location, country, loan_amount
| sort -loan_amount
rules.title: Vehicle GPS Departure Anomaly — High-Value Loans (Splunk SPL)

rules.content:
SELECT la.loan_id, la.application_date, la.vehicle_vin, la.vehicle_value,
       la.loan_amount, la.ltv_ratio, la.dealership_name,
       lp.first_payment_date, lp.last_payment_date,
       lp.payments_made, lp.default_date,
       DATEDIFF('day', la.application_date, lp.default_date) AS days_to_default
FROM loan_applications la
JOIN loan_payment_history lp ON la.loan_id = lp.loan_id
WHERE la.loan_type = 'auto'
AND la.ltv_ratio >= 0.90
AND la.vehicle_value >= 30000
AND lp.payments_made <= 3
AND lp.default_date IS NOT NULL
AND DATEDIFF('day', la.application_date, lp.default_date) < 120
ORDER BY la.vehicle_value DESC;
rules.title: Early Default Anomaly — High-LTV Auto Loans (SQL)
